Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! One more World Cup game to go though as Pakistan take on England. Join us for the action from that game. Till then, take care and goodbye!

South Africa skipper, Dane Van Niekerk starts by crediting Lee for how she played but the fielding let them down, they always try to give their best but today they did not play their best game. States they dropped a few chances today which is not good and they need to improve.

Thailand skipper, Sonnarin Tippoch starts by saying credit to Lee as she hit the ball really hard, they did not get it right and they need to improve. Further adds it was a big score on the board, they went out there and backed themselves but fell well short.

PLAYER OF THE MATCH, Lizelle Lee, says that it is just one of the days for her. She further adds she did not do that well at the start of the tournament but she is happy to do well here. On her partnership with Sune Luus she says that the partnership with Luus was superb. Further goes onto add that they are taking each and every game as a semi final.
The South African bowling was good! Ismail and Luus were the pick as both finished with a three-fers. Except for Khaka, every bowler took a wicket at least.

Once again Thailand have been beaten quite easily! Just what South Africa would have wanted as this would boost their NRR! To be honest after Lee's ton which took South Africa close to 200, it was always going to a huge task for Thailand. Also, to make matters worse, they lost a lot of wickets at the start and then kept on losing wickets throughout. Kamchomphu did play an attractive innings which was the only positive for Thailand.

OUT! The game ends with the first ball of the 20th over. Shabnim Ismail finishes it off in style here. She comes charging in and bowls one on a length and around middle and leg. Padunglerd goes for the wild swing but misses it to see her leg pole lay flat on the ground. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 113 RUNS!

NOT OUT! The batter is just in! Outside off, it is hit towards cover. The batswomen go for a run. The fielder picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs. The batter though has started walking back. She now turns and starts walking back towards the pitch. Replays show that she is just in. Maybe she would have thought that the 20 overs have been done.
Full and outside off, the batter swings but misses.
A single now as this is hit down to long off.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and on off, it is lofted over the mid off fielder and a boundary results.
A single as this is eased down to long off.
Outside off, this is slapped towards cover. Nothing from the freebie.
A full toss on off, it is guided towards point for two. No ball signaled which means Free Hit coming up.
OUT! CAUGHT! No doubt about this one. 9 down are Thailand! This is short and on middle, Laomi looks to pull but gets a top edge towards mid-wicket where the fielder takes it.

NOT OUT! The batter has her foot just in! This is tossed up outside off. Laomi looks to go big but is beaten by the away turn. The keeper collects the ball and whips the bails. An appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Time for the replays which shows Laomi did drag her foot out but she got it back in time.
A stumping appeal has been taken upstairs. The South Africans do not seem very excited.
One more single as this is chipped down to long on.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Shorter and on middle, it is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Flighted ball on off, it is dragged down to long on for one.

OUT! LBW! Three reds! Did not see that coming. Trisha Chetty is once again in the scheme of things as she is the one who convinces her skipper to take the review. It is tossed up on middle and leg, Sutthiruang goes for slog by moving across her stumps. She misses it and gets rapped on the pads. There is an appeal but the umpire shakes her head. The South African go for the review. Replays roll in and Snicko confirms no bat involved. Now comes the Hawk Eye. Pitching in line, Impact in line and what we see is hitting too in line as the ball clips the leg stump on the outside. Did not look like hitting the stumps to the naked eye.
An appeal for LBW has been turned down! South Africa review. Looks to be going down with the angle.

FOUR BYES! Length ball but down the leg side and Chanida looks to play it fine down towards fine leg. She misses it and the ball goes past the keeper and into the fence at fine leg. The umpire gives it as byes.
Floated and on off, driven through covers for a couple.
Length and on off, the batter lofts it over mid on and fetches a couple.
Good length and outside off, the batter fails to lay bat on ball as the keeper collects it.
Tossed up on off, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, driven to mid on for a single.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. They pick up a single.
OUT! STUMPED! Trisha Chetty does another stumping. It is tossed up around off, The ball spins past the slog of Liengprasert and the keeper does the rest.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on the pads, tucked away towards the leg side for a single.
Floated ball on off, pushed to covers for a run.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Length and on the pads, Liengprasert flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a run.
Length and on off, driven through covers for a single.

DROPPED! South Africa have had a poor outing in the field as they have dopped a lot of catches here. This is bowled on a length and on leg, Sutthiruang goes for the slog but gets a top edge towards fine leg where the fielder gets a hand to it only to spill it in the end. A couple is what the get.
On a length and on off, driven towards mid off.
Length ball on off, pushed towards mid off.
Full on off, driven to mid on.
Flatter and on middle, pulled towards the leg side for a single.
Floated on off, chipped over mid on for a single.
Floated and on off, Sutthiruang pulls it but finds short mid-wicket to perfection. The ball goes away from the fielder the and the batters take a single.
Tossed up on off, the batter slogs it towards mid-wicket for a run. 50 up for Thailand.
Tossed up on off, defended off the back foot.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter and on off, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and on off, the batter tucks it to the leg side and gets to the other end.

OUT! STUMPED!  Nattaya Boochatham is out of here. Van Niekerk tosses one up and around off, Boochatham comes down the track to flick it to the leg side but gets beaten as the ball spins away from her. The keeper Trisha Chetty does the rest as she whips the bails off.
Tossed up on off, tucked to square leg.
Full toss on off, played to mid off.
Uses her feet and eases it down to long off for one.
A single as this is hit down to long on.

OUT! CAUGHT! Luus gets a wicket! Slower through the air and outside off, Kamchomphu swings across the line. There is a faint bottom edge which the keeper pouches. A good little innings comes to an end. It would not have made any difference to the outcome of the game though.
Flatter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Gives it a lot of air and lands it on middle, it is swept through square leg for one.
A full toss outside off, Boochatham slashes but misses.
Luus is on now!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

DROPPED! Dane Van Niekerk drops a sitter. Similar to the one how Lee got dismissed in the first innings. It is dragged on and Kamchomphu chips it straight back to the bowler who drops it. A life for Kamchomphu.

SIX! Thailand gets their first maximum of the tournament. What a moment for them. It is short and on middle, Kamchomphu slogs it across towards mid-wicket and gets it to sail over the ropes for a maximum.
Tossed up on off, Kamchomphu drives it to mid off.
Floated ball on off, The batter pulls it but not off the middle off the bat and just about clears mid on there. The batters take two.
Flatter and on off, pulled to mid-wicket.
Driven towards the mid off region.
short of a length ball on off, punched through covers for a single.
Length and on off, pushed to covers.
Yorker on off, the batter does well to dig it out.
FOUR! That's even better. Kamchomphu cuts this length ball outside off through point and gets a boundary.

FOUR! In the air... Just over the fielder there. Length ball  on off, Kamchomphu lofts it over mid off. The fielder there looks to go for the catch but the ball evades her outstretched hands and into the fence at long off.
Tossed up on off, tucked to the leg side this time.
Tossed up on middle, Kamchomphu drags her sweep toward mid-wicket and gets a single.
Floated and around off, stroked towards covers.
Flatter and on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and around off, driven towards mid off.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Dane Van Niekerk is on now!
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for two.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Short and wide and put away! Kamchomphu cuts it through point and it races away to the fence.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! Nothing on Ultra Edge and the batter survives! It is on a length and around middle, the batter looks to flick but the ball moves away. It goes past the outside edge. The keeper takes it and appeals. Up goes the finger. Boochatham reviews. Replays show that the on-field call has to be overturned.
Boochatham has been given out caught! She reviews immediately.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Floated ball on off, Boochatham pushes it to covers.
Floated on off, defended to point.
Flatter and outside off, Kamchomphu pulls it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler off the back foot.
Onnicha Kamchomphu walksout to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant fielding there to send the Thailand skipper packing into the hut. This is tossed up on off and Tippoch looks to squeeze it through covers but gets it uppishly towards covers. Wolvaardt there dives full length to her right and the ball sticks into her palm. Thailand's poor show with the bat continues.
A maiden! Outside off, Boochatham swings but gets an inside edge. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Shortish again around off, it is guided to point.
Length and around off, it is guided to point.
One more short ball and on middle, NB once again looks to play the upper cut but misses.
Slower one outside off, the batter swings but misses.
Shorter in length and around off, the batter looks to upper cut it but misses.
On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
One more tossed up ball on off, defended.
Tossed up on off, it goes on with the arm. Tippoch looks to defend but is beaten.
Flatter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Slower through the air on off, it is defended.
Floats it up on off, it is hit back to the bowler.
Length and on off, defended off the back foot towards point.
Length ball on the pads, Tippoch tucks it towards the leg side and gets a single.
Hat-trick avoided. Tippoch pushes this length ball towards point.
Sornnarin Tippoch walks out to face the hat-trick ball!

OUT! TIMBER! Ismail is too quick for the Thailand batters. She bowls one on a length and gets it to tail back into the batter. Chaiwai is stranded on the back foot as the ball hits the pads on it's way to hit the middle stump.
Naruemol Chaiwai is the new woman in.
OUT! BOLWED! Ismail is on fire. Koncharoenkai departs for a golden duck. It is bowled on a length and Nannapat does not know when the ball goes past her defense and rattles the stumps.
Nannapat Koncharoenkai walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Again Thailand start poorly with the bat. Ismail bowls one on a length and outside off, Boochatham gets and inside edge as she goes for the slog. It rolls towards the keeper where Chetty has a direct hit at the keeper's end and finds Chantam short of her crease. The umpire takes it upstairs and the replays roll in to show that Chantam was well short of her ground when the bails lit up.
Run out chance taken upstairs. It looks out to the naked eyes. Lets see what the replays have to say.
Floated up on off, Chantam is solid in defense.
One more ball and it is kept out again.
On middle, blocked.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Outside off again, it is guided to point.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Chantam opens the face of the bat and runs it past point and into the fence at third man for a boundary.
FOUR LEG BYES! Short and on the pads, Chantam goes for the pull only to miss it. The ball goes off the pads towards fine leg fence.

DROPPED! 2nd drop in 2 overs. poor from South Africa. Ismail goes short and Boochatham goes for the pull only to get a top edge towards mid off where the fielder drops it after getting a hand to it. A run taken.
Length ball outside off, Boochatham makes a leave.
Short ball on off, Chantam pulls it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Length ball around off, Boochatham swing swings it across to get and inside edge to the leg side for a single.
Shabnim Ismail to bowl from the other end.
Floated on off, Chantam prods forward and keeps it out.
Tossed up around off, Chantam keeps it out off the back foot this time.
Tossed up on off, Chantam keeps it out off the front foot.
Floated on off, defended off the back foot towards the off side.
Flatter and on off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.
DROPPED! A chance goes abegging. Flatter and on middle, Chantam pulls it over mid-wicket where Shabnam Ismail drops an easy chance to concede a single. Thailand off the mark here.

We are back for the chase. The two Thailand openers Nattakan Chantam and Nattaya Boochatham will open the batting for Thailand. South African players are also out too. Nonkululeko Mlaba with the ball for South Africa.
